pages: The grey water is not the stone. The stone is only where it gathers. I have it now in a bottle: rainwater from the turned ground, left forty nights in a vessel of clean bone, with a thread of what the Paladin leaves in the soil where he was bound. It is warm. It should not be warm. One drop in a cup of wine and the drinker stops dying within the week. Whether he stops living is a matter of dose, and I am still learning the dose.
